scripts.wasm:dev: npm run wasm:clean && wasm-pack build ./emulator-wasm --target web --out-dir ../src/wasm --dev
scripts.wasm:build: npm run wasm:clean && wasm-pack build ./emulator-wasm --target web --out-dir ../src/wasm --release
scripts.wasm:rebuild: cargo clean --manifest-path emulator-wasm/Cargo.toml && npm run wasm:dev
